**SCENE ID:** CH05_SC001
**CHAPTER:** 5 — THE FALL OF THE CENTER
**START TIME:** 30:00
**END TIME:** 30:58
**DURATION:** 58 s = dialogue 17 s (5 lines, 28 words, emotional pace) + action beats 35 s (run in 8, smoke reveal 5, Mark kneels 6, Elena kneels and Sam recoils 5, Arin reads the panel 5, Sara hears the shaft 6) + reactions 6 s (Elena's face after the accusation 3, Mark's look at Elena 3)
**LOCATION:** INT. GENERATOR ROOM, level B1 service wing — NIGHT, 02:40
**CHARACTERS:** Arin, Sara, Mark, Dr. Elena, Sam
**STORY PURPOSE:** Sam's panic has a reason the others didn't know — the convoy waiting below the hill — and he says it to Elena's face: she knew they were coming.
**VISUAL DESCRIPTION:** A long concrete room filled by a dead diesel generator and a breaker wall. The breaker panel is black and smoking, one cabinet door hanging off. A laminated instruction sheet is half melted. Sam sits against the generator housing, his palms and fingers burned black from the arc, his red work fleece scorched at the cuffs. Mark's spare rifle lies a metre away. In the floor near the far wall, a square steel hatch to the B2 service shaft stands open.
**CAMERA SHOTS:**
1. 3P tracking back, 24 mm, the four running down the service corridor in orange battery light, flashlights bouncing — 8 s
2. POV Arin, 28 mm, handheld-steady, through the hanging door: smoke, the panel, Sam on the floor — 5 s
3. 3P medium, 35 mm, Mark kneeling to Sam, Sam's lines 1–3 — 9 s
4. CU Sam, 50 mm, burned hands held up, shaking — 4 s
5. 3P over-shoulder Sam, 40 mm, Elena kneels, Sam jerks away; Sam's accusation — 8 s
6. CU Elena, 65 mm, no answer — 3 s
7. CU Mark, 65 mm, turns his head to Elena — 3 s
8. Insert POV Arin, 50 mm, the melted sheet: «...قطع برق اصلی، سپس اهرم» — the lever was never pulled — 5 s
9. 3P medium Sara, 35 mm, she turns toward a sound; rack focus to the open hatch behind — 6 s
10. Slow push-in, 35 mm, to the black square of the hatch — 7 s
**CHARACTER ACTION:** The group runs in. Mark slings his rifle, kneels, grabs Sam's forearms (not the hands) to look. Elena kneels on the other side and reaches for Sam's wrist to take a pulse; Sam pulls his arm away and pushes himself back against the generator with his heels. Arin steps over the spare rifle, reads the sheet on the panel, glances at the untouched red lever. Sara stays in the doorway, hears dragging in the floor and turns her whole body toward the hatch.
**FACIAL EXPRESSIONS:** Sam — tears, mouth open, eyes going between faces, then hate when he looks at Elena. Mark — jaw tight, controlled. Elena — clinical calm that cracks for one frame at "تو می‌دونستی". Arin — fast reading, frown. Sara — head cocked, listening, breath held.
**DIALOGUE:**
**سام:** [crying] [panicked] فقط می‌خواستم درو باز کنم... [short pause] ماشینا پایینِ تپه‌ن. اومدن دنبالِ دکتر!

**مارک:** [breathless] [firm] دستاتو نشون بده. [short pause] سام! دستاتو!

**سام:** [sobbing] نمی‌تونم تکونشون بدم...

**SOUND EFFECTS:** Running boots on concrete; flashlights' plastic clatter; electrical crackle and the tick of cooling metal; Sam's wet breathing; a ventilation fan winding down; at the end, from the hatch, a soft drag of fabric on metal, a zipper's teeth scraping.
**MUSIC:** No score until shot 9; then a single low cello note, rising slowly under the push-in.
**LIGHTING:** Orange battery emergency lamps (2700 K, low), smoke catching the flashlight beams; the panel still glows from embers; the hatch is pure black.

**LOCATION:** INT. GENERATOR ROOM, B1 — NIGHT, 02:42
**CHARACTERS:** Sam, Mark, Arin, Sara, Dr. Elena, Infected Z3 (crawler in body bag)
**STORY PURPOSE:** Sam, the coward of the group, saves Mark — and is bitten. The infection is now inside the shelter's people.
**VISUAL DESCRIPTION:** A man drags himself out of the hatch on his forearms, the lower half of his body still inside a torn black body bag from B2 cold storage, frost on his grey skin, legs useless. He moves fast and low.
**CAMERA SHOTS:**
1. Low angle at floor level, 24 mm, the crawler's hands come out of the hatch and pull — 8 s
2. 3P wide, 28 mm, it shoots across the floor and grabs Mark's ankles; Mark goes down — 5 s

5. 3P medium, 35 mm, Arin hauls Sara back to the wall — 3 s
6. POV Mark, 28 mm, rifle up — Sam's body keeps crossing the line of fire — 4 s
7. 3P wide, 28 mm, Sam rolls it off, Mark fires once; the muzzle flash fills the room white — 3 s
8. Static wide, 28 mm, smoke, stillness, high ringing (silence beat) — 5 s
9. CU Sam, 50 mm, he pulls his collar down: a bite at the shoulder — 5 s
10. CU Elena, 65 mm, she looks, closes her eyes once — 4 s
11. 3P medium low, 35 mm, Arin drops to his knees beside Sam — 7 s
**CHARACTER ACTION:** Crawler grabs Mark's boots and pulls; Mark kicks, loses the rifle grip. Sam, using elbows and burned hands, throws his weight onto the crawler. They roll; Sam screams. Arin pulls Sara back by the jacket. Mark recovers, aims, waits, fires the moment Sam rolls clear. Sam sits up, pulls the scorched fleece collar aside. Elena leans in, looks, sits back on her heels.
**FACIAL EXPRESSIONS:** Sam — pure terror becoming disbelief at the bite. Mark — rage, then a terrible stillness. Elena — eyes closed, lips pressed. Arin — shock, mouth open. Sara — hand over her mouth.
**DIALOGUE:**

**سام:** [shouting] [desperate] برید! برید!

**سارا:** [screaming] سام!
**SOUND EFFECTS:** Plastic of the body bag tearing; nails on steel; Mark's body hitting the floor; scuffle; one rifle shot (huge in the concrete room) then a 4 kHz tinnitus ring and dull room tone; Sam's shocked breathing returns first.
**MUSIC:** The cello note from SC001 cuts dead at the shot. No music after.
**LIGHTING:** Same orange battery light; the muzzle flash is a single-frame white key light (frame 45760 approx.); smoke thicker after.
**BLENDER REQUIREMENTS:** ENV_GENERATOR_ROOM. ZOMBIE Z3_CRAWLER_BAG (crawler variant with PROP_BODY_BAG_TORN cloth sim on lower body, frost material). **TRANSITION:** Straight cut on Arin's knees hitting concrete to Sam's face, same light (continuous time).
**CONTINUITY NOTES:** Sam bitten at the LEFT shoulder (infection 0 → onset). Crawler dead (head shot off-frame). Mark picks up the spare rifle: he now carries his own rifle (6 rounds left) and the spare (empty magazine). Mark's sleeve blood-stained.
**CLIFFHANGER OR STORY CHANGE:** Sam is bitten. Everyone in the room knows what happens next.
